explanationBullets: The matcher recognized the family asus, but that family guide is not seeded in the current project yet.
Use the fallback guide for the general flow, then continue to advanced troubleshooting if the router labels differ too much.

notes: "asus" matches the Asus family alias exactly, but no guide in the 6-guide sample catalog belongs to that family (topCandidate is nil — nothing scores >0 for a query no keyword/token relates to) — falls to recognizedFamilyFallbackResolution. Asus isn't a mesh family (isMeshFamily returns false), so the fallback guide is bestAvailableGenericRouterGuide(), not the mesh one.
